Parent plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_0d26b92b5bc8819181fab088efc0283c

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
test/zaq/channels/disk_file_delivery_integration_test.exs and email_file_delivery_integration_test.exs, plus minimal test/CI provisioning. Existing datasource APIs create signed Records for two real Disk files; trusted Outgoing Event selects one. Real Materialization/Channels/Jido/Mailer. Mattermost recipient downloads actual post file; SMTP receiver raw MIME is decoded and compared. Keep fixtures/assertions reusable for later Agent scenarios.

## Tests to add before implementation
Scenarios defined now, authored after final feature review: exactly selected bytes/name/MIME, thread/audience/receipt; empty-attachment control; two concurrent journeys per channel and Mattermost/email together; observe overlap and no crossed resources or cleanup.

## Branches/paths validated
True delivery E2E boundary starts at Outgoing, no Agent/LLM/IMAP ingress claim. Existing ServerManager blocker matters only if actually reached. Agent PR adds ingress/tools later in same modules and retains these scenarios.

## Mocking plan
Real disposable Mattermost/PostgreSQL and SMTP receiver; no mocked upload/materialization/internal dispatch. Unique identities/connectors/mailboxes/files, private sandbox ownership and explicit process allowances. No Application env mutation, global Mox, shared default fixtures or fixed sleeps.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse existing provider provisioning/readback patterns and datasource permission APIs. Reuse zaq-o9d setup only where it satisfies real-server acceptance. Test helpers remain test-only; no production functions for observation.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Implementation progress through .4 complete/pushed; .5 in progress and .6 human feature approval remains required before E2E authoring. Docker Desktop installed but daemon stopped when checked; parent launched existing Docker app to prepare future disposable-provider test prerequisite, without installing software or modifying host settings. Production changed-line audit through .4 is 418 additions+deletions across six planned files, below <1500 target; DeliveryConfirmation seventh file remains .5.

Pre-authoring isolation audit (test-isolation-audit skill): new modules, baseline0 tests; existing Agent disk suite is synchronous due ServerManager startup DB reads, but this Channels-only boundary never reaches it. Existing MattermostHistoryFixture is a simulated HTTP server, unsuitable real receipt; DiskConfigFixture.get_or_create! upserts shared default, unsuitable parallel fixture. Proposed resources: persisted People/config/grants owned per DataCase private Sandbox; filesystem namespace/unique volume per journey under configured storage base, cleanup only own root; actual Mattermost sender/recipient/team/private channel per journey with owned IDs; unique Mailpit recipient/CC/from/message IDs, websocket connection per journey and deletion only own accepted message. Production config/adapter registry are shared immutable reads, never mutated; no global Mox/ETS/names/env setters/default connectors. Datasource get_file and outgoing Event use real NodeRouter with explicit config IDs and trusted actor. Dependencies resolved per Event (identity/config), per persisted connector (provider credentials), per call (source handler), direct production Jido/Mailer clients. Test setup creates sources and grants, datasource API returns two lazy signed Records; selected one goes through actual materialization/provider; recipient readback compares exact bytes/name/MIME, thread/audience/receipt; source bytes remain intact before owned fixture cleanup. Tasks start behind an explicit message gate after SQL Sandbox.allow(Repo,self(),pid). Both actual external acceptance receipts must be observed while both journeys remain live before readback/cleanup is released, proving overlapping resource lifetimes without fake transport, production observation hook or sleep. No shared Sandbox mode; DB access local same BEAM through real role routing. Readiness: ready for focused async experiment; external provider provisioning pending disposable containers/images. Action reuse: reuse datasource/permission APIs, Channels Events/NodeRouter/Materialization/Jido/Mailer; prior module-context maps remain valid. New provider bootstrap/readback helpers are test-only fixture administration against actual servers, no product Action or alternate upload path. No production edits planned. Human approval .6 recorded and closed by parent authorizes these exact two real-provider E2E modules. Infrastructure owned by parent in parallel; no user containers touched.

Implementation progress: authored both requested modules with7 real-provider scenarios plus shared test-only ChannelFileDelivery helper, uniquely scoped disposable Compose/bootstrap script and dedicated CI job. No production changes. Helper uses actual datasource get_file Events for two physical files per journey, signed lazy Records/current person grants, real NodeRouter/Materialization/provider clients; only selected Record travels. Recipient Mattermost token downloads file from final post; actual Mailpit websocket new-message acceptance precedes raw MIME decode/readback. Private DataCase owners, task PID Sandbox allowances before release, both external receipts must exist before readback/cleanup release; exact-byte checks and successive owned-root cleanup verify no crossed resources. No env mutation, Mox, provider/dispatch mocks, source/shared defaults or fixed journey sleeps. Only bounded sleep is external bootstrap readiness. All7 tests compile and are excluded under normal tag selection; not counted as real-provider execution. mix q passes after intentional cleanup reduction result asserted, shell syntax/Python AST/docker compose config/diff checks pass. Parent external provisioning still pulling Mattermost/Postgres images, Mailpit image available; Docker stargz finalization slow. Live receipt runs remain mandatory and no commit/completion yet. Compose image placeholders will be pinned to reviewed RepoDigests once resolved. Existing browser E2E docs and zaq-o9d simulated fixtures reviewed; no Agent/LLM/IMAP claim or ServerManager dependency.

Real SMTP milestone: mix test test/zaq/channels/email_file_delivery_integration_test.exs --include integration --max-cases2 with ZAQ_FILE_DELIVERY_SERVICES=/tmp/zaq-juu7-runtime.json passed3 tests (selected signed file, empty control, two concurrent SMTP journeys),1.7s. Actual Mailpitv1.32.0 SMTP accepted via gen_smtp; websocket new-message event used for synchronization; raw MIME downloaded and Mail parser decoded exact non-UTF8 bytes/name/MIME, Message-ID/In-Reply-To, sender/to/cc and receipt. Source datasource/ACL/materialization/NodeRouter path was real. Owned file cleanup isolation passed and only each accepted Mailpit message deleted. New fixture corrections: SMTP url/token required nonnull metadata fields, and port follows existing string settings contract; no production defect/change. Existing focused regressions passed171 total (6 properties,165 tests),45.5s. Logs /tmp/zaq-juu-7-smtp-real.log and /tmp/zaq-juu-7-regressions.log. Parent PG16/Mailpit started privately; Mattermost image still pending Docker finalization. Compose pins PG/Mailpit supplied RepoDigests, MM placeholder not final; full real-provider suite and actual disposable script run still required before completion/commit.

Concurrency proof strengthened after initial SMTP pass: each task reports monotonic start immediately before actual NodeRouter send and timestamp when its real confirmed receipt returns; test asserts max(send starts)<min(acceptance returns), independently of subsequent readback barrier. Thus concurrent send-call intervals themselves overlap; acceptance/readback barrier additionally keeps both owned resources live before cleanup. Real SMTP module re-ran green3 tests in1.3s with this stronger assertion. Shared helper/new modules self-review finds no Application/System env setters, global Mox, sleeps, fake servers or Req.Test. Full source/helper changes still test-only, no production changes. Current remaining blocker is real Mattermost image provisioning; parent owns Docker investigation, no duplicate pulls or user-resource changes by this agent. Required MM/mixed run, pinned MM digest and end-to-end provisioning-script execution remain outstanding; issue not complete/uncommitted.
